The Media Desk

Where Ops Meets Creative

Currently completing a Diploma in Public Relations at UNISA — a deliberate bet on the intersection of operations and media. The interest shows up in the work already: brand coordination for Self-Care Sundays and OdiumBA, content calendars, campaign visuals, and a habit of treating a brand's presence as something to be run with the same structure as a scorecard. It's also exactly why creative and media-industry operations roles are where she wants to go next.
